options.content:
### ExternalAuth Lifecycle Overview

Fleet-wide and per-resource view of ExternalAuth provisioning health.
Use the **Subscription** and **Resource ID** dropdowns above to drill into specific resources.

**User Journey**: `PUT ExternalAuth → Accepted → AwaitingSecret → Provisioning → Succeeded`

**SLO Targets** (PROPOSED — pending formal review via ARO-25935)
| SLI | Target | Metric |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Availability | 99% in Succeeded state | `backend_externalauth_provision_state` |
| Timeliness | 95% of creates < 15 min | `backend_resource_operation_*` |
| Error Rate | < 1% operations Failed | `backend_resource_operation_phase_info` |
| Degraded Health | 95% non-degraded | `backend_externalauth_degraded` |
| Saturation | CPU < 85% of requests | `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total` |

**Runbook**: Pending publication via [ARO-25934](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/ARO-25934)

panels.title: Total ExternalAuths
panels.description: Total number of ExternalAuth resources across the fleet (or filtered by subscription/resource).

panels.title: Provisioning State Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of ExternalAuth resources by provisioning state.

targets.expr: count((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|provisioning"}) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Create >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth create operations running longer than 15 minutes. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked waiting for OIDC client secret).

targets.expr: count((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|updating"}) > 600) or vector(0)

panels.title: Update >10m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth update operations running longer than 10 minutes. Matches the BackendAsyncOperationExternalAuthUpdateStuck alert threshold (600s).

targets.expr: count((time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="deleting"}) > 900) or vector(0)

panels.title: Delete >15m
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth delete operations running longer than 15 minutes. Only covers direct DELETE operations — ExternalAuths removed by parent cluster deletion do not create operations and are not tracked here.

panels.title: AwaitingSecret
panels.description: ExternalAuths waiting for the customer to create the OIDC client secret. These are customer-blocked and excluded from stuck/timeliness metrics.

panels.title: Degraded ExternalAuths
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth resources currently in Degraded state. Degraded means the ExternalAuth is provisioned but one or more OIDC clients are failing health checks.

panels.title: Healthy ExternalAuths
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth resources NOT in Degraded state. All OIDC clients are passing health checks.

panels.title: Degraded OIDC Clients
panels.description: Number of individual OIDC client components currently failing health checks across all ExternalAuth resources.

panels.title: OIDC Client Health Detail
panels.description: Per-OIDC-client health status for each ExternalAuth. Value 1 = Degraded (client failing health checks), 0 = Healthy.

panels.title: Degraded vs Healthy Over Time
panels.description: Count of degraded vs healthy ExternalAuth resources over time. A rising red line indicates worsening health.

panels.title: Degraded OIDC Clients by Component
panels.description: Per-component OIDC client degradation over time. Each line represents a specific OIDC client component (e.g. console, CLI) that is failing health checks.

panels.title: ExternalAuth Request Rate
panels.description: Rate of HTTP requests to ExternalAuth ARM endpoints (PUT, PATCH, DELETE, GET), per second.

panels.title: ExternalAuth Latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Frontend HTTP response latency for ExternalAuth endpoints. This is the time from ARM request receipt to synchronous response (not the full async operation duration).

panels.title: ExternalAuth Error Rate by Code
panels.description: Rate of 4xx and 5xx responses for ExternalAuth endpoints. Spikes here indicate validation failures (4xx) or server errors (5xx) at the ARM API layer.

targets.expr: (time() - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"}) * on(resource_id, subscription_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) group_left() backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"accepted|awaitingsecret|provisioning|updating|deleting"}

panels.title: Active Operations
panels.description: All currently in-flight ExternalAuth operations with their elapsed duration. Includes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked). Color indicates severity: green (<5m), yellow (5-15m), red (>15m). Note: only shows direct CRUD operations — ExternalAuths removed by parent cluster deletion do not create operations.

panels.title: In-Flight Operation Duration
panels.description: Real-time elapsed duration of each in-flight ExternalAuth operation. Excludes AwaitingSecret. Rising lines indicate stuck operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.5, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p50
panels.description: Median duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.95, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

targets.expr: quantile(0.99, (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}))

panels.title: Create Duration p99
panels.description: 99th percentile duration of completed ExternalAuth create operations.

panels.title: Longest In-Flight Op
panels.description: Duration of the longest currently in-flight ExternalAuth operation. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked).

panels.title: Completed Ops (7d TTL)
panels.description: Total completed ExternalAuth operations within the 7-day Cosmos TTL window. Note: update durations include both RP processing and HyperShift reconciliation time. Separating these requires hypershift_cluster_identity_providers from the HCPs workspace (not available in the services datasource).

targets.expr: count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="succeeded"}) / count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) * 100

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of completed ExternalAuth operations that succeeded.

targets.expr: backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}

backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="update", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="update", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}

backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="delete", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="delete", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}

panels.title: Operation Duration by Type (Completed)
panels.description: Duration of completed ExternalAuth operations (last_transition_time - start_time). Only visible within the 7-day Cosmos TTL window.

panels.title: Provisioned Ratio
panels.description: Percentage of ExternalAuth resources currently in Succeeded provisioning state. Note: this does NOT reflect runtime health — use the Degraded Health section for true availability.

panels.title: True Availability (Non-Degraded)
panels.description: Percentage of ExternalAuth resources that are NOT degraded. This is the true availability signal — an ExternalAuth can be Succeeded but degraded (OIDC clients failing).

targets.expr: (count((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"}) < 900) or vector(0)) / count((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded"})) * 100

panels.title: Timeliness SLO (Create <15m)
panels.description: Percentage of successful ExternalAuth create operations that finished within 15 minutes. Failed/canceled operations are excluded — only successful creates count toward timeliness.

targets.expr: count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}) / count(backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled"}) * 100

panels.title: Operation Error Rate
panels.description: Percentage of completed ExternalAuth operations that ended in Failed state.

panels.title: In-Flight Operations
panels.description: Number of ExternalAuth operations currently in non-terminal phases. Excludes AwaitingSecret (customer-blocked).

panels.title: Provisioned Ratio Over Time
panels.description: Fleet-wide ExternalAuth provisioned ratio over time.

panels.title: Provisioning State Over Time
panels.description: ExternalAuth count by provisioning state over time.

panels.title: Parent Cluster State Distribution
panels.description: Provisioning state of all HCP clusters in the selected subscription(s). Note: shows ALL clusters in the subscription, not just parents of the selected ExternalAuths.

panels.title: Clusters Not in Succeeded State
panels.description: All HCP clusters NOT in Succeeded state in the subscription. ExternalAuth operations on these clusters will fail or remain stuck. Note: subscription-wide, not filtered to ExternalAuth parents.

targets.expr: count by (operation_type) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"})

panels.title: Failed Operations by Type
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by operation type (create/update/delete).

targets.expr: count by (subscription_id) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"})

panels.title: Failed Operations by Subscription
panels.description: Count of failed ExternalAuth operations grouped by subscription.

panels.title: Failed ExternalAuths by Subscription
panels.description: Count of ExternalAuth resources currently in Failed provisioning state, grouped by subscription.

targets.expr: backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="microsoft.redhatopenshift/hcpopenshiftclusters/externalauths", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}", resource_id=~"$resource_id", phase="failed"}

panels.title: Failed Operations Detail
panels.description: Detail table of all ExternalAuth operations in Failed state with their duration.

panels.title: ExternalAuth Traffic Over Time (RPS)
panels.description: Request rate to ExternalAuth endpoints over time, broken down by HTTP method.

panels.title: Backend Saturation — CPU & Memory (SLO 85%)
panels.description: Backend pod CPU and memory utilization as a percentage of resource requests. Red line at 85% SLO threshold.

panels.title: Saturation — CPU
panels.description: Current backend CPU utilization as percentage of requests.

panels.title: Saturation — Memory
panels.description: Current backend memory utilization as percentage of requests.

panels.title: Backend Pods
panels.description: Number of running backend pods.

panels.title: Cosmos RU/s
panels.description: Current Cosmos DB request unit consumption rate per second.
